description: Register this checkout's repo-scoped marketplace with Codex CLI in a scratch home, install the plugin, and confirm without a model that Codex loaded PAN's MCP server and skills.
why: Plan item 4d/4f's gate for Codex, deepened by market-ideas M31 (2026-10-03): the steps after the marketplace ask Codex what it loaded, the shape the Agent Plugins conformance CI uses (install, then MCP status) plus the skill catalog Codex renders into a prompt, all model-free. Every codex step runs with CODEX_HOME at a scratch home under <other>: until 2026-10-03 this gate set none and registered the dev marketplace in the user's real ~/.codex/config.toml. First run live 2026-09-26 on Codex CLI 0.157.1; the discovery steps were measured on the same build on 2026-10-03. SKIPPED with reason when the CLI is absent.

steps.why: The repo's .agents/plugins/marketplace.json points at ./dist/pan-agent-plugin, so the bundle must exist there before Codex can resolve the entry.
Codex refuses a CODEX_HOME that does not exist yet ("failed to resolve CODEX_HOME"), so the scratch home is created first. The script refuses the real home and its dot-directories.
Codex reference: `codex plugin marketplace add <source>`; a local repo path is an accepted source. Its stderr on failure is the evidence to adjust from.
The marketplace registered under the name in .agents/plugins/marketplace.json.
The install the conformance CI starts from: Codex copies the bundle into its plugin cache and reports where.
Codex's own view of the plugin after the install.
The bundle's mcp.json reached Codex: the `pan` server is configured and enabled, read without starting a session or calling a model.
The skill catalog Codex renders into a model's prompt lists PAN's skills under the plugin's namespace. `debug prompt-input` builds the prompt without sending it, so no login and no model.
